run.change_description:
Update conn state to prevent concurrent connection attempts

Make callers of resetBackoff() lock the mutex

Add doc comment for resetTransportAndUnlock

Merge remote-tracking branch 'source/master' into fix_conn_connect_race

summary.intent: Close the window in addrConn.connect() and updateAddrs() where ac.mu was released before resetTransport re-acquired it, so two goroutines could both see Idle and start parallel connection attempts (grpc-go#7365, orphaned transports); resetTransport becomes resetTransportAndUnlock, called with ac.mu held.
summary.issue_fit: Met. Issue #7365 and the PR text were supplied as a spec (no forge access); the described root cause is closed on both callers, with the requested doc comment present.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (clientconn.go) reviewed with callers, onClose, tearDown and the balancer serializer path. Focused tests at the head, once each: `go test -race -run 'Test/(ResetConnectBackoff|UpdateAddresses|BackoffCancel|BackoffWhenNoServerPrefaceReceived|TestDial_OneBackoffPerRetryGroup)' .` passed; `go test -race -count=20 -run Test/AuthorityRevive ./xds/internal/xdsclient/tests` passed 20/20. Two concurrency safety premises were verified in one awaited batch and both hold. No regression test was added by the change, and the reported 100000-run result was not reproduced. The PR review history was supplied as text only and is not a prior review by this reviewer.

observations.fact: The second commit is titled 'Make callers of resetBackoff() lock the mutex' but it performs the resetTransport to resetTransportAndUnlock lock-ownership change; the message names the wrong function.

requirements.source: pr-body/"caller of `resetTransport()` keep holding the mutex"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:922 and clientconn.go:996 call resetTransportAndUnlock with ac.mu held; verified premises premise-connect-atomic and premise-updateaddrs-handoff hold

requirements.source: pr-body/"no concurrent requests are able to start"
requirements.evidence: state becomes Connecting under the same ac.mu hold as the Idle check (clientconn.go:914-1261); premise-connect-atomic holds

requirements.source: issue-7365/root-cause: two connect() calls both see Idle
requirements.evidence: Test/AuthorityRevive passed 20/20 with -race at the head; the unlock-before-reset window is removed in connect() and updateAddrs()

requirements.source: pr-body/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes for 100000 attempts"
requirements.evidence: Measurement not repeatable within the run allowance; 20 focused runs passed, which is compatible but not proof of a 0.4% flake fix

requirements.source: pr-body/RELEASE NOTES: client: fix race that could lead to orphaned connections
requirements.evidence: Orphaned transport path (createTransport's late-close branch) is no longer reachable by two concurrent attempts started via connect()

tasks.premise: ac.mu is held from connect()'s Idle check through setting Connecting, so no two goroutines can both start a connection attempt from Idle.
Handing ac.mu to the goroutine in updateAddrs cannot deadlock or leave the mutex locked, including with the deferred GracefulClose to onClose.
